verificationScope.note: The clean checkpoint passed 560 frontend unit tests, TypeScript, the production Web build, 158 full-run Playwright cases plus 2 focused cases after repairing one stale privacy-copy contract, native Control/Voice/Desktop builds with codesign verification, managed Pi v2 packaging and smoke, import/route/Ruff/mypy gates, and focused backend verification. The latest 2,952-test backend run had one SQLite test-literal error that was repaired and rechecked narrowly rather than hiding the nonzero full-run exit. Automated evidence does not replace user-authorized foreground IME, Accessibility, microphone, signing, notarization, or clean-machine installation acceptance.

releaseEvidence.note: Release flags are declarations only. scripts/check_public_release.py recalculates artifact/evidence hashes and blocks while the real manifest or any listed file is absent or mismatched.

resolvedBlockers.evidence: canonical bundle audit found exactly one patched bundle in the user Input Methods directory
HIToolbox and third-party input-source entries are complete; Squirrel is selectable and was selected successfully for the controlled soak
The configured 34-case model count gate passed with minimum 3 and average 3.0 candidates; 25 warm installed-service probes had a 100% three-candidate rate.

The current 20-sample complete-response benchmark returned three candidates for every sample at p50 117 ms and p95 251 ms. This is backend service evidence, not foreground first-visible or semantic-quality proof.

A reviewed production-candidate run, explicitly separated from raw checkpoint output, scored semantic judgment coverage 1.0, Top-1/Top-3 0.0, boundary validity 0.833333, continuous-Tab 0.0, p50 92 ms, and p95 187 ms. The gate itself preserves candidates; the production provider may parse/filter before this stage.

The obsolete 20k template corpus, its generators, stale handoff files, archived agent-process subtree, browser console, and duplicate InputMethodKit frontend were removed in the history-rewritten baseline fb4ef14; the public audit reports no forbidden tracked artifacts.

Project-authored source is now GPL-3.0-only with a canonical top-level LICENSE, SPDX package metadata, a recorded copyright holder/year, and a release-manifest evidence slot that hashes the license file.
Checkpoint bd405fd builds the production Web Control Center, all three native helper apps, and the pinned managed Pi v2 payload from clean source; the native app markers record gitDirty=false.

The public build contract now requires Pi commit e807fc845a1d4709f61dbd0e37d6f7acb24a4f12 and source-contract sha256 37ea18af329508495926310be95bc284c17413c1b8c0f6e09cb8a1b6cbef202d, including deterministic Goal continuation, Session memory-refresh epochs, native read/grep/find/ls/edit/write/bash projections, governed Room target binding, bounded semantic tool-result evidence, and a pre-dispatch model-context fence. Earlier runtime smoke against an older pin is not acceptance evidence for this checkpoint.

blockers.detail: The source and packager contract now require Pi e807fc845a1d4709f61dbd0e37d6f7acb24a4f12, but a clean managed payload build and deterministic staged Runtime smoke for that exact commit have not yet been recorded.
Current trace does not prove the full Rime composition, delete resync, app-switch invalidation, and follow-up-after-selection matrix.

The latest backend benchmark completed three candidates for every sample at p50 117 ms and p95 251 ms, but backend response time is not foreground first-visible latency and the current Squirrel build still needs a fresh measured run.
A real foreground overlay now shows separate model and RAG candidates, but RAG or memory selection and feedback remain unverified.
Selected-text capture, replacement, stale rejection, and commit still need a real foreground proof.

The active MiniMind deployment passes backend latency and three-candidate count, but the reviewed production-candidate baseline scored semantic Top-1/Top-3 0.0, boundary validity 0.833333, and continuous-Tab 0.0 at full human-judgment coverage. Raw checkpoint output still needs its separate gate. Retraining or a network/checkpoint change and real single-user evaluation are required.

The working-tree Squirrel overlay has native popover material, source-aware rows, bounded animation/TTL, and Reduce Motion handling, but no fresh real-foreground screenshot of v3 has been accepted. Static source/build checks and debug fixtures do not satisfy this gate.
The Keychain-backed Doubao PCM probe passes, but partial replacement, finalization, cancellation, and sensitive-field blocking still need one user-authorized foreground microphone run.

The native Rime-only selection endpoint, patched Squirrel hook, review-only export, and automated tests pass, but a fresh real composition selection has not yet produced the foreground feedback trace and reviewed deployment proof.

The shared React Control Center now builds for both the native host and the authenticated same-origin Agent Gateway, RagImeVoice remains headless, and the legacy debug console remains removed; fresh native and tailnet user-facing release acceptance runs are still pending.

The Accessibility-only desktop bridge and quick-generate window-context route build and pass automated contracts, but TCC grant, live target-app inspection, approved action execution, and foreground quick-generation context still need one user-authorized macOS run.

Any distributed patched Squirrel source or binary must include the pinned corresponding source, GPL-3.0 license and notices, plus retained librime notices; release packaging has not yet proven that bundle.

Current local native builds use development/ad-hoc signing evidence only. A public macOS release still needs an owned bundle/version plan, Developer ID signing, notarization, stapling, and clean-machine Gatekeeper verification.

A deterministic unsigned engineering staging archive now combines patched Squirrel, the one RagImeControl control center, the Accessibility-only RagImeDesktopBridge, headless RagImeVoice, and corresponding source. It is deliberately releaseEligible=false and is not a public package: hash-bound license/notices/source evidence, clean commit, foreground evidence, Developer ID signing, notarization, stapling, installation/rollback acceptance, and output/release/release-manifest.json remain missing.
